categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Build system' label and modifies Guix build scripts, manifests, and toolchain configurations under contrib/guix/.
categories.rationale: Updates the Guix time-machine commit to enable newer compiler toolchains (Clang 22/23, GCC 16) and drop obsolete package workarounds. As routine release infrastructure modernization that does not fix an active release breakage or immediate security vulnerability, it provides real value but is reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Touches Guix manifests and scripts under contrib/guix/, which are build and release tooling rather than developer utilities.
categories.rationale: Build and release scripts are explicitly excluded from the tools category and belong to build.
